verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no official Jan client libraries for Python, JavaScript or other languages. Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API at localhost:1337 and an Anthropic-compatible endpoint that third-party SDK clients can point at. Compatibility with other vendors' SDKs is an adjacent workaround, not a Jan-shipped client library, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript

citations.quote: you can use Anthropic SDK clients pointed at your local server
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer
